parameters.name: EndpointIds
parameters.description: The unique ID of the accelerated mount target that is associated with the slot.

parameters.name: InstanceIds
parameters.description: The unique ID of the dataset acceleration instance to which the slot belongs. For more information, see [ListInstances](~~467899~~).

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the dataset acceleration slot. Fuzzy matching is supported.

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description:
The sort order. Valid values:

- Desc: Descending order.

- Asc: Ascending order.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the slot list. The value starts from 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of slots to return on each page. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: Phase
parameters.description:
The status of the dataset acceleration slot. Valid values:

- Created: The slot is created.

- Preparing: Resources are being prepared.

- Loading: Data is being loaded.

- Running: The slot is running and providing services.

- Reloading: Data is being reloaded.

- Succeed: The operation is successful.

- Failed: The operation failed.

- Stopping: The slot is being stopped.

- Stopped: The slot is stopped.

parameters.name: SlotIds
parameters.description: The IDs of the dataset acceleration slots. Separate multiple IDs with a comma (,).

parameters.name: StorageType
parameters.description:
The data storage type of the dataset acceleration slot. Valid values:

- OSS: OSS file storage.

- NAS: NAS file storage.

parameters.name: StorageUri
parameters.description: The data storage path (URI) of the dataset acceleration slot.
